description: This file contains a test suite for the low-level memory allocator in the Abseil library, including memory pattern checks, randomized allocation/deallocation, and arena management, executed before main() via static initialization.

classes.name: BlockDesc
classes.description: Structure representing a memory block with a pointer, length, and fill pattern.

classes.name: BeforeMain
classes.description: Static struct that runs memory tests before main() via constructor.

methods.name: CheckBlockDesc
methods.description: Verifies that the memory pattern in a BlockDesc is intact.

methods.name: RandomizeBlockDesc
methods.description: Fills a BlockDesc with a randomized pattern.

methods.name: Test
methods.description: Performs randomized memory allocations and deallocations, testing LowLevelAlloc functionality.
